target: Casey reported achieved fiscal-quarter fuel margin excluding credit-card fees; includes RIN economics; no substitution of MUSA retail target
evidence: Original SEC-referenced quarterly releases or call transcripts, raw hashes, publication date, current-quarter margin, fuel gallons and numeric current-quarter RIN proceeds; ambiguous/noncomparable evidence remains unresolved
rin_component: 100 * disclosed quarterly RIN proceeds dollars / disclosed quarterly fuel gallons; gross component proxy; require RIN reduction-of-fuel-cost basis from source/filing and do not equate proceeds with total RIN fair-value income after accounting change
base_component: reported margin minus disclosed RIN proceeds per gallon; use existing fiscal expanding YoY four-feature ridge alpha2 half-strength seasonal-anchor engine, minimum8 earlier available component targets and valid fiscal prior-year anchor
rin_forecast: arithmetic mean of four latest earlier published quarterly RIN proceeds per fuel gallon; no target-quarter RIN input, RIN price fit or realized blending volumes
baselines: existing own-basis fiscal model; same-quarter prior-year margin; prior-year anchor plus half mean of last4 available reported YoY changes (recent-level seasonal baseline)
eligibility: Only complete supported component records with publication strictly before target end for training; no backfill from later annual columns. Target publication only used for later scoring
geography: Retain archived Casey weights. No unsupported historical state or gallon weights inferred; dated historical geographic reconstruction remains unsupported in this experiment
sample: All eligible fiscal quarters, report earlier and start>=2021 separately, >=5c original comparator misses descriptive not activation
accounting_break: Fiscal2027Q1 RIN recognition change separately flagged; block strict proceeds decomposition if total recognized RIN income cannot be equated with proceeds
promotion: Existing gate and comparison with both simple baselines; no automatic promotion, no retuning after results
